export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (importkey.com/countries/india/deepak-poly-plast-private-limited) shows 812 total shipment records, 18 trading partners, 27 ports, latest cargo 2026-02-28. Exact row quoted: "2026-02-28 | DEEPAK POLY-PLAST PRIVATE LIMITED | STATPACK INDUSTRIES LTD | MACHINES FOR TESTING THE STRENGTH OF PLASTICS WITH ACCESSORIES 01 50 KGF ELECTRONIC LOADCELL WITH CALIBRATION CERTI S | SH- SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | NAIROBI, Kenya | 90318000 | 1114275". Additional dated export rows seen: 2026-02-25 to DURA-LINE MIDDLE EAST LLC, MUSCAT, OMAN, HS 90318000, BOL 1004484; 2026-02-20 to AL ZAMIL WATER TANKS, JEDDAH, SAUDI ARABIA, HS 82089090, BOL 9856988; 2026-02-18 to MHG MASCHINENFABRIK HOMBAK GMBH, Hamburg, GERMANY, HS 82089090, BOL 9792641; 2026-02-13 to ENER PLASTICS L.L.C., Jebel Ali, UAE, HS 84749000, BOL 9658188. Source counter: page claims 812 shipments; 5 individual dated rows actually visible on the free view (rest paywalled).
note: Export side is factually confirmed: five dated outbound customs rows with destination, HS code and bill-of-lading numbers, all in Feb 2026, from Ahmedabad/Sahar air cargo and ICD Sabarmati. Note the declared HS 732690 (iron/steel articles) does not match any observed shipment line — actual codes seen are 90318000 (measuring/testing instruments), 82089090 (knives/cutting blades) and 84749000 (parts of machinery for working mineral substances); the company appears to be a plastics-processing-machinery and spares trader/manufacturer, not a metallurgy/steel supplier. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground: HS should be corrected to the factual codes and verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: web_search returned a connection error on both attempts and volza/eximpedia free views returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is unknown rather than none_found — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free view: null, not estimated. Role: manufacturer_trader (sells own ancillary machinery plus third-party spares, e.g. MHG, Pallmann, Al Zamil).
